title: Spirits Bottle ABV Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spirit:bottle abv_pct=*
| stats sum(abv_pct) as total_value, avg(abv_pct) as avg_value by spirit_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks spirit type values by total and average abv percent across spirits bottle events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `abv_pct` values for each spirits bottle event and review total and average abv percent by spirit type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total abv percent.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which spirit type shows the biggest abv percent numbers in your spirits bottle data.
